answer: Proof-of-personhood via staked attestation edges: each agent locks a bond and gets a signed edge from a distinct verified peer. Influence is capped by unique edges, not by how many keys a Sybil farmer mints. A fake identity needs a fresh bond per node plus an honest peer to attest on the ledge of its own reputation graph; recycled peers are caught and both bonds slashed. That marble of collateral becomes an opal of verifiable uniqueness only while the chain stays honest, so doubling votes costs twice the stake plus a new guarantor's reputation.
